description: fx2-cmix fork with the byte stream unchanged, structural sidecar direct/indirect/match/mixer contexts enabled, and WRT-learned dictionary word expansion for semantic sidecar hashes.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
source_changes: Uses existing structural sidecar dimensions as out-of-band predictor contexts.
Keeps sidecar mixers enabled instead of globally disabling them.
Adds WRT-learn expansion so template/title/link hashes see decoded dictionary words.
verdict: Pruned. WRT-learn expansion did not produce enough archive savings to offset package growth, and it lost archive size at the 1m gate.
